payload.summary: Found by the first greenfield onboarding attempt (sports-betting-markets, 2026-08-06, visualjc): README quickstart is broken in any repo but nahel itself — 'nahel init' scaffolds no nahel/workflows/, so 'nahel install --agent claude,codex' reports 'no workflow docs — nothing to install'. Fix (visualjc-ratified scope for 0.4.1): embed the canonical workflow docs in the binary at build time (single source: repo nahel/workflows/), init writes them write-if-missing (re-run never overwrites). Drift warning deferred to a separate chore.
